clues.it: Nino era nella 3ª colonna e da solo in Laboratorio.
clues.en: Nino was in the 3rd column and alone in the Lab.

clues.it: Giada era nella stessa stanza di Luca.
clues.en: Giada was in the same room as Luca.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 7ª colonna e nella 4ª riga.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 7th column and in the 4th row.

clues.it: Olga era nella 5ª riga e accanto a un reattore.
clues.en: Olga was in the 5th row and beside a reactor.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Elena era nella 7ª riga e accanto a una grata o a un serbatoio.
clues.en: Elena was in the 7th row and beside a floor grate or a fuel tank.
Paolo was in the Cryo Bay.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 8ª colonna e nella 9ª riga.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 8th column and in the 9th row.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 4ª colonna e nella 10ª riga.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 4th column and in the 10th row.

steps.it: L'indizio di Nino lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Nino's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 3rd.

steps.it: Solo Luca può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 6ª è sua.
steps.en: Luca is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 6th is theirs.
